subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: Should the current Scrapling hide be restored as a false positive, kept hidden under scraping/content policy, or treated as a publish/update visibility regression that needs a code fix?
rationale: The decisive evidence is private production moderation, scanner, audit, and possibly account state, and automation must not unhide or bypass a security-sensitive listing without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review production state and restore if false positive
options.body: Inspect the current skill, version, scan job, audit, and manual-override records, then restore or override the listing if the hide is stale or unintended.

options.title: Keep hidden under policy
options.body: If scraping policy requires this listing to remain hidden, explain the decision to the reporter and connect it to the open content-policy RFC.

options.title: Open a focused code fix
options.body: If production state shows updates wrongly hide a previously clean version, patch that workflow with regression coverage while preserving non-scanner moderation holds.

recommendation.title: Review production state and restore if false positive
recommendation.body: Inspect the current skill, version, scan job, audit, and manual-override records, then restore or override the listing if the hide is stale or unintended.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest recent code history and already handled the prior Scrapling restore and related scraping-policy discussion.
